subject: Map Manual Colours to Fill Category

messages.author: 68b661fcb57b94a9
messages.subject: Map Manual Colours to Fill Category
parts:
ggplotters:

I have a quick question. What needs added or changed to the code below (or removed), in order for the colours that are designated manually to be used to fill the boxplot geom? The code below manually assigns colours to the outlines of the boxplot geom, but it doesn't impact the colours used to fill it. Thanks for your time.

tst<-data.frame(a=c("A","B","C"),b=rnorm(300))
ggplot(tst,aes(a,b,colour=a))+geom_boxplot(aes(fill=a))+scale_colour_manual(values=c("A"="green","B"="black","C"="brown"))
